B (normal form PᵀAP = diag(a_jσ), a_j ≥ 0, on ℝ^{2m}): exp(πA) = −I iff all a_j are odd integers; ⟨A,A⟩ = 2Σa_j²; if exp(πA) = −I, t ↦ exp(πtA) is a minimal geodesic of O(2m) (blind induced metric) iff all a_j = 1; all a_j = 1 ⇒ A² = −I. A ⇒ B: the normal-form computations (exp of the block diagonal, the odd-integer criterion via cos(πa) = −1, the trace, A² = −I) and 'minimal ⇒ all a_j = 1' (compare with exp(πtA₁), A₁ = P·diag(σ)·Pᵀ, length π√(2m): Σa_j² ≤ m with odd a_j ≥ 1) are elementary and do not use A; 'all a_j = 1 ⇒ minimal' needs the global lower bound π√(2m) for every path I → −I in O(2m): the project's Hopf–Rinow argument (proof of riemDist_omegaStratum at k = 0) run with A's pi_sq_mul_card_le_norm_sq.
